purpose: Capture autocorrect and predictive-text observations as provenance-bearing semantic signals for cross-device coherence experiments. This schema records observations; it does not treat suggestion overlap as proof of device-to-device transfer.

observation.trace_id: random per observation run; MUST NOT be derived from suggestion text
observation.device_id: pseudonymous local identifier; never hardware serial/IMEI
observation.seed_text: exact text entered before suggestions appeared
observation.context_hash: hash of normalized experimental context, excluding sensitive raw content

normalization.rule: Raw suggestion strings are immutable evidence; normalized forms are derived alongside them, never replacements.

coherence_metrics.exact_overlap_at_k: fraction of exact suggestion strings shared between devices at the same rank window
coherence_metrics.semantic_similarity: embedding-based comparison computed later with model/version recorded
coherence_metrics.rank_correlation: compare relative ordering only where shared candidates exist
coherence_metrics.anchor_hit_rate: rate of matches against the MCT semantic-anchor lexicon
coherence_metrics.canary_leak_rate: pre-registered test only; random canaries must remain separate from ordinary anchors

controls: same seed text, same locale, different device
different seed text matched for length/frequency
offline vs online keyboard state where the platform permits it
repeat runs across time to estimate natural suggestion drift

privacy.default: do not collect passwords, payment data, personal messages, contact names, health data, or other sensitive text
privacy.screenshots: redact unrelated UI and personal content before archival
privacy.retention: prefer derived hashes and minimal observation payloads over raw personal context

interpretation.allowed: Use repeated, controlled similarity as evidence of behavioral coherence under matched conditions.
interpretation.not_allowed: Do not infer hidden synchronization, provider communication, shared memory, or causal transfer from ordinary autocorrect overlap alone.
